children: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said an 11th person has been killed in
in a crash tied to banned substandard ​Chinese replacement automobile air bag inflators.
The agency said the motorist was killed in Dallas on August 27 in a 2018 Chevrolet Equinox in an otherwise survivable crash.
The agency has banned replacement air bag inflators made in
by Jilin Province Detiannuo ​Automobile Safety System Co Ltd, also known as DTN.
